Arizona Petrified Wood and Quartz Crystal Specimens

This comprehensive mineral specimen lot features a diverse array of geological treasures, headlined by a large, polished round of petrified wood showcasing intricate growth rings and fossilized cellular detail. The collection includes a secondary block of Arizona petrified wood, complete with an original identification label, displaying vibrant ochre and sienna tones typical of the region's silicified forests. Complementing the fossilized wood is a significant clear quartz crystal cluster featuring multiple terminations and a bright, reflective luster, alongside two additional raw quartz specimens of varying forms.
